rca_of_issue: N/A — verification run only. Root cause of original Apple 2.1 rejection (FR error on EN UI) was the wrong branch order in onSubmit: 'typeof detail === string' was evaluated before status===401, so the backend's hardcoded FR detail 'Email ou mot de passe incorrect' overrode the i18n key. Iteration 22's reorder (401 first → t('auth.loginErrors.invalidCredentials')) is in place and working.
